name: kururu
description: A GUI for the agents it runs — on the desktop and on your phone.

scripts.dev:desktop: bun run build:server && KURURU_DEV=1 bun run --cwd desktop start
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd web typecheck
